source.description: Use platform when the user attached a chat file. Use content when the full text body is already available.

platformFileId.description: Required when source is platform. Use the chat attachment fileId.

fileName.description: Original file name, for example todo.txt.

content.description: Required when source is content. Also pass this with source platform when the attachment text is visible in the conversation — the app cannot download chat files with its invocation JWT.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type when source is content.
